```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(plotly)
library(ggfortify)
library(GGally)
library(gridExtra)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

### Loading the dataset

```{r}
df = read.delim("housing-prices-ge19.txt")
```

### Data cleaning
```{r}
df <- df %>% select(-Test)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Waterfront = as.factor(Waterfront),
    New.Construct = as.factor(New.Construct),
    Central.Air = as.factor(Central.Air),
    Fuel.Type = as.factor(Fuel.Type),
    Heat.Type = as.factor(Heat.Type),
    Sewer.Type = as.factor(Sewer.Type)
  )
df <- df %>%
  #Remove houses with invalid lot size
  filter(Lot.Size > 0) %>%
  #Remove old houses that has an age 0
  filter(!(Age == 0 & New.Construct == 0))

df <- df %>% clean_names()
```

```{r}
# cont_vars0 <- c("lot_size", "age", "land_value", "living_area", "pct_college")
categorical_vars <- c("waterfront", "new_construct", "central_air", "fuel_type", "heat_type", "sewer_type")
```


```{r, message = FALSE}
cont_vars <- df %>% select(price, lot_size, age, land_value, living_area, pct_college)
ggpairs(cont_vars) + theme_bw()

cont_vars1 <- df %>% select(lprice, lot_size, age, land_value, living_area, pct_college)
ggpairs(cont_vars1) + theme_bw()

cont_vars2 <- df %>% select(sprice, lot_size, age, land_value, living_area, pct_college)
ggpairs(cont_vars2) + theme_bw()
```

```{r}
for (i in 2:ncol(df)) {
  var_name <- names(df)[i]
  
  if (var_name %in% categorical_vars){
    next
  }
  
  # Construct formula properly
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste("price ~", var_name))
  
  # Fit model
  lm_i <- lm(formula_i, data = df)
  
  # Print which variable is being plotted
  cat("Plotting for variable:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Plot diagnostics
  print(autoplot(lm_i, which = 1:2))
}

```
QQ-Plots don't look linear!

```{r}
df <- df %>% mutate(lprice = log(price))
for (i in 2:(ncol(df)-1)) {
  var_name <- names(df)[i]
  
  if (var_name %in% categorical_vars){
    next
  }
  
  # Construct formula properly
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste("lprice ~", var_name))
  
  # Fit model
  lm_i <- lm(formula_i, data = df)
  
  # Print which variable is being plotted
  cat("Plotting for variable:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Plot diagnostics
  print(autoplot(lm_i, which = 1:2))
}
```

```{r}
df <- df %>% mutate(sprice = sqrt(price))
for (i in 2:(ncol(df)-2)) {
  var_name <- names(df)[i]
  
  if (var_name %in% categorical_vars){
    next
  }
  
  # Construct formula properly
  formula_i <- as.formula(paste("sprice ~", var_name))
  
  # Fit model
  lm_i <- lm(formula_i, data = df)
  
  # Print which variable is being plotted
  cat("Plotting for variable:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Plot diagnostics
  print(autoplot(lm_i, which = 1:2))
}
```

```{r}
p1 = df |> ggplot() + 
  aes(x = lot_size, y = price) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  labs(x = "Lot size",
       y = "House price") +
  geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE)
p1
p1 + scale_y_log10()

p1 + scale_x_log10()

p1 + scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10()

ggplot(df, aes(x = lot_size)) + geom_boxplot()
ggplot(df, aes(x = lot_size)) + geom_histogram()
```
